newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder cuts Mobil on price.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder cuts Mobil on price.

text.p: Schroder Wertheim analyst Michael Mayer Wednesday cut the rating on Mobil Corp's stock to market performer from outperform.

-- "Mobil is up 15 percent over the past three months, and is now at our target price of $141. This price performance compares favourably with the S&P industrials (which is up 8 percent) and the major oil group (which is up 11 percent), and has occurred despite a 22 percent drop in oil prices and a 16 percent drop in natural gas prices this year," Mayer said.
-- he said the downgrade was based solely on price, and there was no change in the earnings estimate of $7.85 per share in 1997.
-- Mayer said the stock has an upside potential of $154, and a downside risk of $129.
-- For the major oils, Mayer said there was no change in Schroder's positive forecasts for oil demand and prices.
-- since stocks such as Exxon Corp and Atlantic Richfield Co have also hit price targets, they were also downgraded to market perform from outperform.
-- Mayer's top pick is Unocal Corp, rated outperform significantly.
-- Texaco Inc and Royal Dutch/Shell are also rated outperform.
